projects.title: Complemento de Álgebra
projects.subtitle: Álgebra lineal y ecuaciones diferenciales para ingeniería
projects.short: An open textbook for engineering students at USACH: from matrices to the Laplace transform, with worked engineering problems.
description: This book grew out of the algebra recitations I taught at the University of Santiago of Chile. It covers the linear algebra and differential equations an engineering student needs, using problems from chemical and mechanical engineering: flow networks, heat-transfer meshes, chemical balances, springs and control systems.
The 2026 edition is a complete clean-up of the original course notes: restructured into chapters, re-typeset in modern LaTeX, with corrected derivations and fully worked solutions.
toc: A · Tabla de transformadas de Laplace
changelog: Split the single 8,000-line file into 8 chapters, a preface and 2 appendices.
Replaced obsolete LaTeX (eqnarray, manual accents) with modern amsmath and UTF-8.
Fixed sign and index errors in derivations; completed worked solutions (Alka-Seltzer stoichiometry, water network, dairy plants, arsine redox).

projects.title: Squeezing light and its role in gravitational-wave detection
projects.subtitle: Review essay · CU Boulder graduate course with Prof. Scott Diddams
projects.short: How squeezed states of light push LIGO below the quantum noise limit.
description: A review of quantum noise in laser interferometers and how injecting squeezed vacuum lowers shot noise, enabling more sensitive gravitational-wave detectors such as LIGO.
